newsitem.title: UK: Oasis says sees lower H1 profit performance.
newsitem.headline: Oasis says sees lower H1 profit performance.

text.p: British fashion retail chain Oasis Stores Plc said on Tuesday that its profit performance in the first half of the current financial year would be materially lower than what was achieved in the same period last year.
The company said its sales growth since the year end has been below its "fairly demanding" expectations.
In addition, the company said it experienced some pressure gross margins due to higher level of markdowns than planned.

"As a result, whilst there is a significant bias to our profitability towards the second half of the year, it is clear that our profit performance in the first half will be materially lower than we achieved in the first half last year," chairman Michael Bennett told shareholders at the annual meeting.
He said the company's like-for-like sales in the first 18 weeks rose four percent while total sales was up 19 percent.
